mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting glucagon to the liver was most worthwhile: it showed how stored glycogen supports blood glucose between meals and how the signal eases afterward.

leastWorthwhile.text: The opening combination felt least worthwhile on its own: it established rising glucose but did not yet explain a response.

surprise.text: The paired insets made it clear that both insulin and glucagon responses ease as blood glucose changes.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though each decision had only one offered combination, so I was following the sequence rather than discovering compatibility.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in continuing to see another body-system connection, though the single available combination at each step made the gameplay predictable.
